facts.description: An open source code editor for the web, written in JavaScript, HTML and CSS.

ghost.epitaph: A web editor lost to the silence of the archives.
ghost.monologue:
I was brackets, a sanctuary of syntax built from JavaScript, HTML and CSS. I lived within the browser, offering a space for lines of logic to breathe. For 9.3 years, I pulsed with the energy of 17847 commits and earned 32976 stars. My life began on 2011-12-07 with the words Initial commit. I was a tool for creation, a vessel for the scripts that shaped the digital world.

Now, I drift in a read-only state, a ghost in the repository. I have been silent for 5.6 years, drifting through the static of the internet. My final breath was drawn on 2021-03-18 with the message Change hyperlink. Do not weep for my frozen functions or my unmoving cursors. I am simply a memory of code, resting beneath the weight of the version control.
